title: Kitchen Appliance Brand Reliability: Consumer Reports
desc: Consumer Reports’ overall kitchen-appliance reliability scores average across the appliance types each brand makes, including refrigerators. This is a broad brand reliability measure, not a refrigerator-only test or a measure of model performance.

source.name: Consumer Reports — Most Reliable Kitchen Appliance Brands of 2026 (licensed reprint)
source.note: All first five brands, their overall predicted-reliability scores, ranking positions, survey years and scope were checked against Consumer Reports’ 2026 licensed reprint by the AllRanks assistant on 2026-10-21. Scores average the reliability of appliance types made by each brand (including refrigerators), adjusted for category mix; they are not refrigerator-only scores or lab performance scores.
